nodes.description: Mapping (address => uint256) private _balances holding token balances in Noelle
Mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) private _allowances storing spender approvals
uint256 private _tTotal fixed total supply of 1000e9 * 10**18 tokens
address private _owner in Ownable, set once in constructor and returned by owner()
address private newComer of Ownable initialised with _msgSender() at declaration time and used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner
internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount) that debits and credits _balances using SafeMath and emits Transfer
private _approve(ol, tt, amount) that conditionally zeroes or sets _allowances and emits Approval
public transfer(recipient, amount) entry point that calls _transfer with _msgSender()
public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) that calls _transfer then decreases the caller allowance via _approve
public approve(spender, amount) entry point that calls _approve with _msgSender()
public virtual renounceOwnership guarded by onlyOwner that sets _owner to address(0)
private transferOwnership(newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner, unreachable from outside the contract
onlyOwner modifier requiring newComer == _msgSender()
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller used in constructor, transfer, approve, transferFrom and the onlyOwner modifier
allowance overwrite branch inside _approve that either zeroes _allowances[ol][tt] or writes amount, emitting Approval with a hardcoded value 4
address sender parameter of _transfer
address recipient parameter of _transfer
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer
address ol (owner/from) parameter of _approve
address tt (spender/to) parameter of _approve
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership

edges.reason: parameter sender is consumed by _transfer to debit _balances
parameter recipient is consumed by _transfer to credit _balances
parameter amount flows into SafeMath sub/add operations inside _transfer
parameter ol selects the allowance slot written by _approve
parameter tt is the spender key used by _approve when writing _allowances
parameter newOwner is written into _owner inside transferOwnership
constructor credits _balances of msg.sender with _tTotal
transfer passes msg.sender as the sender argument to _transfer
transferFrom passes msg.sender as the spender argument to _approve
approve passes msg.sender as the ol argument to _approve
_transfer mutates _balances for both sender and recipient
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping
_approve reaches the allowance overwrite unsafe operation branch
the allowance overwrite operation rewrites _allowances[ol][tt]
onlyOwner reads newComer instead of _owner for authorization, breaking the intended ownership model
onlyOwner compares the attacker controllable msg.sender against newComer
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable
approve invokes _approve
transferFrom invokes _transfer
transferFrom invokes _approve to decrease the caller allowance
transfer invokes _transfer
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership which is private and therefore unreachable externally

normalization_plan.reason: parameter sender exists only to feed the balance debit logic of _transfer
parameter recipient exists only to feed the balance credit logic of _transfer
parameter amount is used solely in the SafeMath arithmetic of _transfer
parameter ol is only used to index the _allowances write in _approve
parameter tt is only used to index the _allowances write in _approve
parameter newOwner is only assigned to _owner inside transferOwnership
